snippet.title: Snuggle Nightmare | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Snuggle Nightmare is a new mascot horror experience that combines exploration, stealth, environmental puzzles, crafting, and parkour in a mysterious abandoned amusement park.

  The official demo launches this June on Steam!

Wishlist Snuggle Nightmare on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4537800/Snuggle_Nightmare/

 Interested in playing the demo before release?

Contact me through any of the following channels to request an early access Steam key:

💬 Discord:
